language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used throughout Omnigent.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how Omnigent looks on this device.
appearance.hostControlled: Theme is controlled by the host application.
appearance.resetDescription: This will reset every appearance choice back to its default.
appearance.modeHelper: Follow your system, or force light or dark.
appearance.terminalThemeHelper: Use a light or dark terminal, or match the app.
appearance.workspacePanelHelper: Whether new chats open with the Files / Agents / Shells panel visible. Existing chats keep their last layout.
appearance.colorThemeHelper: Choose a preset, then tune it across light and dark mode.
appearance.translucentHelper: Lets the canvas show through the conversation and workspace rails.
appearance.hideUnconfiguredHelper: Only show harnesses that are set up on the selected host in the new-chat picker. Harnesses needing a CLI install or sign-in are hidden instead of badged.
appearance.uiFontSizeHelper: Scale text and spacing across the rest of the interface.
appearance.fontFamilyHelper: Use any font installed on this device. Leave blank for the system default.
appearance.codeFontSizeHelper: Size of code in the editor and terminal.
appearance.codeFontFamilyHelper: Font for the code editor and terminal. Leave blank for the default.

cli.title: Local CLI
cli.description: The Omnigent command-line tool this app uses to run a local server and connect this machine as a runner.
cli.resetDescription: Reset the configured CLI path and use automatic detection.
cli.securityNote: For security, a custom path can only be set from the connect screen — this prevents a connected server from pointing the app at a different binary. Open it from the Server menu (Change Server…) and use the settings gear.
cli.missingDescription: The Omnigent CLI wasn't found. Install it, then set its path from the connect screen:
